description: This file contains the implementation of the PDO MySQL driver as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer library for PHP. It defines the class ADODB_pdo_mysql with methods for database interactions, including schema handling, sequence management, and SQL generation specific to MySQL via PDO.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_mysql
classes.description: A class implementing a MySQL driver using PDO as part of an abstraction layer, providing methods for schema operations, sequence generation, and SQL syntax specific to MySQL.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver with specific PDO attributes and transaction capabilities.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Returns MySQL-compatible SQL for offsetting a date by a fractional number of days.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Generates a MySQL CONCAT expression from given arguments.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Gets meta information about database tables, optionally filtered by schema.

methods.name: SetAutoCommit
methods.description: Sets the autocommit mode for the database connection.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with LIMIT and OFFSET.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates a SQL date formatting string based on a specified format.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique sequence ID, creating the sequence table if necessary.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence table with a starting value.
